The original, I believe, is four parts and goes as follys:

↳ Posted by Matt Leavey on January 20th, 2015.

Apologies to PatrickCavanagh - I’ve basically whipped the text you posted and put line ends on.

Came across a handwritten version of this from a workshop - note for note identical to what had been posted above, but only the first two parts. According to McGlinchey, this is a tune that he’d forgotten he’d written (during his hiatus from playing), and that he only rediscovered when he was asked to go on one of the Comhaltas tours (to Australia, if memory serves) . They’d decided to cut it down to two parts for the purposes of the tour, and that’s the way he’s played it ever since. So, most commonly, this is a two part reel. Anyhow, I’ve stuck with all four parts for the sake of completeness, and of course to keep any B McG purists out there happy.

↳ Posted by Matt Leavey on January 23rd, 2015.
